## Script to define the baseline parameters and scenario controls for Model 1A

## Model description

![](images/Model1A.png)

### States

S = Susceptible\
C = Colonised\
I = Infected\
X = Isolated

### Flows

**Admissions**\
CumAdmS = cumulative admitted to S\
CumAdmC = cumulative admitted to C\
CumAdmI = cumulative admitted to I

**Discharges**\
CumDischS = cumulative discharged from S\
CumDischC = cumulative discharged from C\
CumDischI = cumulative discharged from I\
CumDischX = cumulative discharged from X (confirmed, recovered cases)

**Deaths**\
CumDeathS = cumulative deaths from S\
CumDeathC = cumulative deaths from C\
CumDeathI = cumulative deaths from I\
CumDeathX = cumulative deaths from X

**Transitions between states**\
CumSC = cumulative flow from S to C (colonisation)\
CumCS = cumulative flow from C to S (decolonisation)\
CumCI = cumulative flow from C to I (progression to infection)\
CumIX = cumulative flow from I to X (suspected cases)\
CumXI = cumulative flow from X to I (false negatives)\
CumXS = cumulative flow from X to S (confirmed, recovered cases)

### Outcomes to quantify

CumColonisedinHospital = cumulative colonised within hospital = CumSC\
CumInfectedinHospital = cumulative progressed from colonised to infected within hospital = CumCI

CumIncidentCases = cumulative incident cases = CumCI + CumAdmI\
CumSuspectedCases = cumulative suspected cases = CumIX\
CumConfirmedCases = cumulative confirmed cases = CumXS + CumDischX

CumFalseNeg = cumulative false negatives = CumXI\
CumMissedCases = cumulative missed cases (i.e. not tested) = CumIncidentCases - CumSuspectedCases\
= CumCI + CumAdmI - CumIX

CumDaysinX = cumulative isolation bed days = sum of X over time × dt

CumDeathsIX = cumulative deaths in I and X = CumDeathI + CumDeathX\
CumDeaths = cumulative total deaths = CumDeathS + CumDeathC + CumDeathI + CumDeathX

CumExcessDeaths = cumulative excess deaths\
Note this requires two scenarios:\
CumExcessDeaths = CumDeathsIX (baseline mortality scenario mI, mX \> mS, mC) - CumDeathsIX (counterfactual with equal mortality rates)

```{r}

build_model_parameters <- function(scenario_id = "001",
                                     scenario_label = "Baseline",
                                     max_time = 3650,
                                     dt = 0.5,
                                     initial_state = NULL) {
  if (is.null(initial_state)) {
    initial_state \ <- c(
      S = 9500,
      C = 30,
      I = 15,
      X = 5,
      E = 0,= 
      CumCases = 0,
      CumIdentified = 0,
      CumFalseNeg = 0,
      CumDischC = 0,
      CumDischI = 0,
      CumXDays = 0,
      CumDeaths = 0,
      CumCI = 0,
      CumAdmI = 0,
      CumXS = 0,
      CumXI = 0,
      CumXDisch = 0
    )
  }
  
  list(
    scenario_id = scenario_id,
    scenario_label = scenario_label,
    max_time = max_time,
    dt = dt,
    initial_state = initial_state,
    
```

### Admissions

```{r}

A = 20, pS_adm = 0.90, pC_adm = 0.07, pI_adm = 0.03,

```

### Time-to-rate inputs (days)

```{r}
t_incubation = 5, t_decolonisation = 20, t_identify = 1, t_transfer_to_sideroom = 0.5, t_test = 1, t_treat = 1, t_recover = 3, t_transfer_to_ward = 0.5, t_discharge = 0.5, 

```

#### Length of stay inputs (days)

```{r}

LOS_S = 5, LOS_C = 6, LOS_I = 8, LOS_X = 12,

```

### Person to person transmission (beta) / environmental exposure (eta) parameters, and environmental contribution to colonisation (rhoE)

```{r}
betaC = 0.002, betaI = 0.005, betaX = 0.001, beta0 = 0.0, etaC = 0.001, etaI = 0.002, etaX = 0.0005, rhoE = 0.2,

```

# Antibiotics effect on progression C -\> I

abx_mult = 1.5,

# Mortality rates

mS = 0.001, mC = 0.001, mI = 0.004, mX = 0.003,

# Numerical settings

stabilisation_tol = 1e-6, stabilisation_window = 10 \`\`\`
